info.title: NewHeap Platform Database Read Tool
info.description: Inspect selectable SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL and MariaDB schema and run bounded, read-only diagnostic queries through NewHeap configuration profiles, typed JSON input and strict JSON output, one request at a time, in a long-lived session or as a stdio MCP server.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Reads one direct schema search or one versioned JSON request and writes one JSON
response to stdout.
Database connection strings are resolved through a checked-in profile and the normal
NewHeap appsettings/secrets substitution flow. They are never accepted as arguments.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Serve read-only schema and query tools to an agent as a stdio MCP server.

commands.name: query
commands.description: Validate the request, verify the principal and execute the diagnostic query.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Validate the request, verify the principal and inspect selectable schema.

commands.name: session
commands.description:
stdout's first line announces the protocol, before any connection opens. Each stdin
line {"id":"...","command":"query"|"schema","request":{...}} gets one stdout line
{"id":"...","exitCode":<n>,"response":{...}}. A failed request does not end the
session; the end of stdin does, with exit code 0. A session ends by itself after
--maximum-lifetime-seconds (default 3600) or --maximum-idle-seconds (default 300), and
verifies the principal again after --verification-interval-seconds (default 60) and on
every new connection.

commands.name: Streams
commands.description:
stdout  JSON response only
stderr  Reserved for host diagnostics; never contains a connection string

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Dry-run a query or schema request and its profile without connecting.
